capabilities: Rename files with unsafe characters, replacing them with hyphens
Generate a report of all file names that are not sync-safe
Automatically rename new or renamed files to safe names without overwriting existing files
disambiguation: Not a sync service or client; it only renames files so that whatever sync tool you use can transfer them.
intentEvidence: Other plugins like Obsidian Filename Linter Plugin require manual execution. This plugin runs automatically
motivation: The author ran into sync failure notifications on their phone caused by special characters like '?' in file names created on desktop.
problem: Files with certain special characters in their names fail to sync to some devices, such as a phone, leaving users with incomplete vaults.

relations.evidence: Other plugins like Obsidian Filename Linter Plugin require manual execution.

summary: File name sanitizer that renames files containing characters that break cross-device sync, replacing unsafe characters with hyphens.
